questions.question: A triangle has three sides. How many corners does it have?
questions.explain: A triangle has three sides and three corners. The common trap is saying four corners, like a square.

questions.question: A square has four sides and four corners. How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.explain: A triangle has three sides. The trap is mixing it up with a square, which has four sides.

questions.question: A shape has no sides and no corners. What shape is it?
questions.explain: A circle has no straight sides and no corners. The trap is giving it a side or a corner.

questions.question: Maya draws a shape with three straight sides and three corners on her notebook. What shape is it?
questions.explain: Three sides and three corners make a triangle. The trap is mixing up the counts for different shapes.

questions.question: Liam says, 'This square is turned to the side, so it is not a square.' Is Liam right?
options: No, it still has 4 sides and corners.
Yes, when it turns it has three sides.
Yes, a turned square gets new corners.
No, a turned square has no corners at all.
questions.explain: Turning a shape does not change how many sides or corners it has. A square is still a square no matter how you hold it.

questions.question: Ava counts the corners on a rectangle and says, 'It has five corners.' What is the right number of corners?
questions.explain: A rectangle has four sides and four corners, just like a square. The trap is counting one extra corner.

questions.question: Noah draws a shape with four sides, four corners, two long sides and two short sides. What shape is it?
questions.explain: Four sides, four corners, with two long and two short sides, make a rectangle. A square has all sides the same length.

questions.question: Zoe turns her square so the corner points down. How many sides and corners does it still have?
questions.explain: Turning a square does not change it. It still has four sides and four corners. The trap is thinking a turn makes a new shape.

questions.question: Ava draws a shape with four sides, four corners, and all sides the same length. What shape is it?
questions.explain: Four sides, four corners, and all sides the same length make a square. A rectangle has two long and two short sides.

questions.question: Ben says, 'A triangle has four sides and four corners. A circle has one side and one corner.' What is wrong with what Ben says?
options: A triangle has five sides and a circle has two corners.
A triangle has three sides and a circle has no corners.
A triangle has two sides and a circle has three corners.
A triangle has four corners and a circle has no sides.
questions.explain: A triangle has three sides and three corners. A circle has no sides and no corners. The trap is giving a circle a side or a corner.

questions.question: A rectangle has four sides. How many corners does it have?
questions.explain: A rectangle has four corners, one at each end where two sides meet. Count the corners the same way you count the sides.

questions.question: A circle has no straight sides. How many corners does it have?
questions.explain: A circle is round all the way around, so it has zero corners. Corners only form where two straight sides meet.

questions.question: A rectangle has two long sides and two short sides. How many sides does it have in total?
questions.explain: A rectangle has four sides all together: two long and two short. Two plus two makes four.

questions.question: Mia has a triangle and a square on her desk. How many corners do both shapes have together?
questions.explain: A triangle has 3 corners and a square has 4 corners. Add them up: 3 plus 4 makes 7.

questions.question: Tom is counting the corners on a triangle. He has counted two already. How many more does he need to count?
questions.explain: A triangle has three corners in total. Tom counted two, so he needs one more. Three minus two is one.

questions.question: Kai says, 'A triangle has four sides and a circle has one corner.' What is wrong with what Kai says?
options: A triangle has five sides and a circle has two corners.
A triangle has three sides and a circle has one side.
A square has four sides and a circle has one corner.
A triangle has three sides and a circle has no corners.
questions.explain: A triangle has three sides, not four. And a circle has no corners at all because it is round all the way around.

questions.question: A shape has four sides and four corners. Two of its sides are short. How many of its sides are long?
questions.explain: The shape has four sides. If two are short, the other two must be long. Four minus two is two.
